title: Activity: the engine asks one step to run
description: The engine-to-step call (build-way 4.2). Engine-neutral on purpose: the same object is a Temporal activity input or a row in our own step journal. Existing Yard stations run through scripts/run-bounded.ps1 with timeoutSec and maxMB. A rerun with the same idempotencyKey must not repeat the step's effect.

name.description: The step: a station or activity name (freshen, ci-wait, merge, docs).

args.description: Named arguments: strings, numbers, booleans, or lists of strings. Never a secret value (secrets are read at run time by the step).

idempotencyKey.description: <wo>:<name>:<attempt> or any stable key; the same key means the same effect.
